messages:
Sara Chen: quick sync 1- we need a short onboarding checklist for new rollout/AB signals for the compare dashboard. who can help map labels and ingestion contract? :wave:

Michael Rivera: i can own dashboard pieces. what signals exactly? latency, error_rate, cost_per_token, eval_diffs? :thinking:

Rong Li: add kv_cache_hit_rate and queue_depth from runtime too. they explain tail behavior. we must standardize label names for reliable joins.

Oliver Kline: proposed canonical labels: service, model_name, model_variant, route, region, rollout_id. use snake_case to stay consistent with prom/grafana templates.

Emily Park: include quota_tier and customer_namespace for dedicated/private so finance splits aren't noisy.

Michael Rivera: for dashboard ingestion contract i need: metric_name, labels (canonical set), unit, aggregation window. example I want in the PR:
```
metric: runtime_request_latency_ms
labels: service, model_name, model_variant, route, region, rollout_id
unit: ms
aggregation: p50,p95,p99 over 1m
```

Rong Li: on telemetry side exporters must attach rollout_id (router sets it). if missing map to `control` and emit a sparse diagnostic event. we'll also validate label set on ingest.

Sara Chen: can we require router to add x-rollout-id header? non-blocking missing-id metric for 2w then roll to mandatory.

Oliver Kline: yes router will add x-rollout-id and augment model_variant/route metadata. i'll draft the router patch. @Rong will you own telemetry mapping rules?

Rong Li: yup. i'll add a normalization layer that rewrites labels to canonical names and emits a `telemetry.normalized_metric` line for staging validation. also adding an ingest-lint job that runs a tiny query set against new metrics.

Emily Park: cost signal spec: metric cost_per_token_usd and clarify token_accounting label = {request,response,total}. also add currency=USD label per finance ask.

Michael Rivera: dashboard rules: panels join on (service, model_name, route, rollout_id). optional split by quota_tier. regression alerts use delta thresholds on p95 + eval_score drops.

Sara Chen: eval scores: push as metrics (prefixed eval_) or pull?

Oliver Kline: push as metrics prefixed `eval_`, include eval_set and threshold labels. lets overlay eval curves with latency/cost.

Rong Li: watch cardinality: our pipeline drops labels with >8 unique values in some stages. ensure route & model_variant are low-cardinality; otherwise expose `route_group` or hashed id. if we see >100 variants we switch to model_variant_group.

Emily Park: add dashboard annotation with commit id and rollout policy (quantization/batching enabled) so perf deltas are explainable.

Michael Rivera: panels i'll add: p50/p95/p99 latency, error_rate, cost_per_token, eval_regression_rate, kv_cache_hit. each panel gets rollout_id dropdown and a compare-to-control toggle.

Sara Chen: action items:
- Oliver: router header + patch (ETA 2d)
- Rong: telemetry mapping + ingest-lint job (ETA 3d)
- Michael: dashboard templates + alerts (ETA 4d)
- Emily: cost metric spec + billing_unit label (ETA 2d)

Oliver Kline: will post PR. can someone share a small promql snippet to validate against?

Michael Rivera: sample promql for p95 by rollout:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_request_latency_bucket{service="inference"}[1m])) by (le, rollout_id, model_name, route))
```

Rong Li: i'll run ingest-lint and check label cardinality on staging slice. if >100 variants switch to model_variant_group.

Emily Park: finance requires currency=USD label on cost metrics; we'll ensure tagging.

Sara Chen: i'll open a tiny PR template for signal onboarding (ingestion contract + checklist) and link it from console docs. ping me to pair on header semantics. :rocket:

Michael Rivera: :thumbsup: cc me, i'll hook panels to rollout registry.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: router-api v2 -> staging at 2026-06-05T14:32:00Z (unrelated)

Sara Chen: great, thanks all. i'll start the doc and the onboarding PR.

Oliver Kline: pairing acked. +1.

Rong Li: starting mapping PR now, will attach test queries.
